sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and direct-run check
sections.what: Loads the replay list, the ingest function and the database client. Runs the seeding only when the file is run directly.
sections.why: Lets other code import the seeding function without starting it.
sections.watch_out: Importing this file does nothing on its own.

sections.name: seedFixtures
sections.title: Seed the fixtures
sections.what: Ingests every committed event, counts results per sport, logs them, and reports sports that were skipped and the store totals.
sections.why: The logs tell the owner what was and was not loaded.
sections.watch_out: Counts show only new incidents, so a repeat run reports zero, which does not mean something is broken.

summary: Loads the committed sample sports data into the local database through the app's normal ingest path.
purpose: Gives a local database real, sourced data to show and test against, without invented records.
why: The file header says only real sourced data may be seeded, using the same adapters and rights checks as the app.
how: Gets the replay events, ingests each one, counts events and new incidents per sport, logs what was skipped and the totals, and disconnects from the database when run directly.
inputs: The committed fixtures, through the replay service.
outputs: Database rows, log lines, and per-sport counts returned to the caller.
risks: Only replay data is seeded; live feeds are never loaded here. An ingest error stops the run.
debug: Read the log lines. A sport marked not seeded shows the reason.
